channel.title: Insider Media Ltd - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Insider Media Ltd (insidermedia.com)

item.title: Utility detection firm facing administration after bad weather dampens recovery hopes
item.description: A utility detection and mapping business in Doncaster is now under "severe financial pressure" and could be placed in administration after orders dried up over the last year.

item.title: Harrier Park 'construction ready' after multimillion-pound preparation works
item.description: The historic Harrier Park site in Hucknall is now 'construction ready' following the completion of multimillion-pound preparation and enabling works.

item.title: Multimillion-pound Bilston Market takes shape as traders visit their new home
item.description: The new multimillion-pound Bilston Market being built by Speller Metcalfe is taking shape, with traders taking a look at their new home.

item.title: £2bn investment fund unveiled by Liverpool City Region
item.description: A £2bn Liverpool City Region Investment Fund - the largest of its kind announced for the region - is ti be unveiled at MIPIM. Initial investments will focus on bringing forward high-quality office space in Liverpool city centre alongside new lab space and tight industrial units across the wider city region.

item.title: Savills makes promotions in Bristol and Exeter
item.description: Property consultancy Savills has unveiled a series of promotions within its Bristol and Exeter offices.

item.title: NI drug development spin-out wins Zinc growth funding
item.description: A Belfast-based firm has been named the winner of Discovery Park's start-up growth programme for innovations in cardiovascular health, securing £250,000 in funding from venture capital firm Zinc.

item.title: Funding sought for landmark drone and defence technology cluster in Swindon
item.description: A drone and defence technology cluster could be set up in Swindon if a newly submitted bid is approved in the coming weeks.

item.title: Denholm Good Logistics expands with UK3PL partnership
item.description: Denholm Good Logistics, a logistics provider and member of the Denholm Logistics Group, has invested in UK3PL Ltd, a specialist e-commerce logistics trading as Pro3PL.

item.title: £36m industrial and logistics scheme proposed for Wolverhampton - backed by Richardson family business
item.description: An industrial and logistics specialist has submitted plans for a £36m development on a business park in Wolverhampton, with the project backed by the Richardson family business.

item.title: Kwik Fit training facility in Mallusk showcased to mayor
item.description: Kwik Fit’s training facility in Mallusk has been hailed by the mayor of Antrim and Newtownabbey who meting the next generation of automotive technicians and saw how the company is investing in local talent.
